display_name: Starting check: Staff with a work phone
description: A short check for staff with a work phone at Tarrowby Logistics, a fictional company, taken before the awareness episodes (pair BA). Ten items from a Tarrowby work phone: texts, printed notices with QR codes, and emails. The result is kept so the matching after-check (awareness_post_mobile_ba) can show how the two compare.
organiser_note: each role's check tests the channel that role meets in its episode, and in a session that runs more than one episode only the learner's primary-role check is recorded.
